research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Enlightra is engaged in the development of photonics technology, focusing on an optical assembly that includes a laser and an optical waveguide. This assembly is designed to emit light and provide a multifrequency optical resonator, which aligns with their goal of enhancing extreme-bandwidth data transmission. The integration of these components suggests a focus on improving data transmission capabilities through advanced photonics solutions.
